title: Does anybody want to help me make a popular fighting game with ai and unity engine.
author: Majestic-Doughnut803
selftext: I have all the ideas set, just need help with insight and reprehensible work practices.

comments.author: Useful_Use_6170
comments.body: I can help ya send me a DM

comments.author: weverz
comments.body: So whats holding you back from straight up asking if right away?

replies.author: Majestic-Doughnut803
replies.body: Its aa lot of work and lines of snippets codes and stuff

replies.author: CruelAngelsThesaurus
replies.body: You're already cutting out 90% of the work, how damn lazy are you?

replies.author: -svde-
replies.body: laziest damn thing i think i’ve seen someone say in these subs lol. what is even the point? i’m sure the ideas aren’t much either.

replies.author: Majestic-Doughnut803
replies.body: The ideas are very lucrative and original. I just have been making music for the game and it takes a lot of workflow to do it by yourself

replies.author: -svde-
replies.body:
if you aren't even willing to do the work it takes to prompt the AI yourself, for the most base level of vibe coding ever, which is essentially just chatting at this point, it is highly unlikely you have put enough thought into something to have a very lucrative or original idea. 

vibecoding aspect aside, you know that plenty of people have made huge, fun, complex games with insane workflows and indepth stories/mechanics/art/etc entirely by themselves for decades, and continue to do so, right? no one needs an "idea guy". i don't think it's a good thing, but ideation is probably the easiest thing to offload to an AI. 

also wtf do you mean "reprehensible work practices" in the original post? do you know what reprehensible means? it's not a good thing lol.

replies.author: Majestic-Doughnut803
replies.body: I probably meant apprehensively. I heard the ai in the other comment would do it all. The idea is lucrative because it's something other gamers haven't taken the scale to. Think of ninja gaiden raised to a dbz extent  you gotta think about what you're talking About man. Included with power buffs and consumables that'd have made a mainstream popular game that no one has yet done for the community. Sure people make miracle games in their past tense work patterns but I need a team to get started and doing it alone is different when not having made a game with ai yet. I've been making the music currently and to have a team would make this better

comments.author: CruelAngelsThesaurus
comments.body:
There is no way some random ass dude on reddit manages to get netcode down to the point you can make any fighting game worth a damn. 

This weird mentality that you have a magic idea to make the next hit is exactly why no one takes people who use AI seriously, you can't even set up a working model to present to get other devs interested.

Ideas don't mean shit without execution, everyone has ideas.
